lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ho2Mg12Mo2 (HoMg6Mo) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ho centers coordinated by 16 neighbors, while Mg adopts several environments, including a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 neighbors, and Mo centers surrounded by 12 Mg neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among 12-vertex Mg coordination polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Ho and Mg polyhedra; the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
